result.text: The synthetic greenhouse trial employed temperature sensors recording one reading every ten minutes over seven days [00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011]. This measurement schedule did not enable evaluation of crop yields or determination of energy-saving benefits [00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011].

citations.title: Synthetic greenhouse sensor trial
citations.quote: In a synthetic greenhouse experiment, temperature sensors recorded one reading every ten minutes for seven days. The trial evaluated data collection reliability; it did not measure crop yields or establish an energy-saving benefit.
